name: proxy-starter
notes: ADR-023 tier 1: an engineering gate. A number from this set decides whether a retrieval switch earns its place and is NEVER cited as a finding about CIT-U research. One question per paper is a starting point, not a target -- fifty is ADR-023's number, and a question may expect passages from more than one paper. Fill `question` and `quote`, delete the `category` key if you like, and run with --dry-run after every few. Leave a slot as TODO and pass --drop-incomplete to measure what is labelled so far.
